headline: LII Q2 Deep Dive: Residential Weakness and Guidance Cut Overshadow Commercial Gains
summary: Climate control solutions innovator Lennox International (NYSE:LII) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026 as sales rose 3% year on year to $1.55 billion. Its GAAP profit of $7.73 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Carrier Beat Estimates, Raised Its Outlook, And Fell Anyway
summary: The market looked past a small earnings beat to a profit that is still shrinking and a raised target that leans heavily on the back half of the year.

headline: Why Lennox (LII) Stock Is Down Today
summary: Shares of climate control solutions innovator Lennox International (NYSE:LII) fell 20.1% in the afternoon session after the company reported second-quarter results that missed revenue estimates and provided a full-year profit forecast that fell short of Wall Street's expectations.
